svg.title: LinearPFN, animated
svg.desc: Three datasets in turn. The rows of each dataset stream in one after another; cell shades show values, and the outcome y is a linear function of the selected predictors. The inclusion-probability bars move from the prior with every row; then the selected features light up (x1 and x3, then x2, then x2 and x3) and the rows are sorted by y, so the selected columns turn into the same light-to-dark gradient as y.

transform: translateY(0px); animation: row1 27.30s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.2,1) 0.00s infinite both

transform: translateY(-104px); animation: row5 27.30s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.2,1) 0.00s infinite both
